the patient’s clinical deterioration was most likely due to immune complex-mediated injury in the liver and lungs.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this patient’s liver and lung disease was caused by hepatitis B vaccine, which induced a silent infection with hepatitis B virus and a subsequent immune complex-mediated injury to the liver and lungs.
hepatitis B virus infection may have been present in the patient and may have been the cause of his clinical deterioration, although the exact pathogenesis remains unclear.
the hepatitis B vaccine may be a cause of immune complex-mediated hepatitis, which may lead to liver failure, acute respiratory distress syndrome, and death.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the vaccine should be used with caution in patients with preexisting liver disease.
the hepatitis B vaccine should be used only when indicated, and it should be used with caution in individuals with a history of autoimmune disease.
clinicians should remain vigilant for the possibility of vaccine-associated immune-mediated organ injury.
